theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 29 群

items.pos: v. 提升；籌募 | n. 加薪
items.colloc: raise money 募款 | get a raise 獲得加薪
items.distinct: rise 上升（不及物）| lift 舉起（物理動作）
ex: Management decided to raise the minimum wage.
管理層決定提高最低薪資。
We need to raise funds for the campaign.
我們需要為活動籌募資金。
She asked her boss for a salary raise.
她向老闆要求加薪。

items.pos: n. 參考；推薦信；提及
items.colloc: job reference 工作推薦人 | for future reference 供日後參考
items.distinct: preference 偏好 | reverence 尊敬
ex: Please keep this file for future reference.
請保留此檔案供日後參考。
The candidate provided excellent professional references.
該候選人提供了優秀的專業推薦人。
He made a brief reference to the new policy.
他簡短地提及了新政策。

items.pos: adj. 定期的；規律的；普通的
items.colloc: regular basis 定期地 | regular customer 常客
items.distinct: frequent 頻繁的 | constant 持續不斷的
ex: We hold regular meetings every Tuesday morning.
我們每週二早上舉行定期會議。
She is a regular customer at this coffee shop.
她是這家咖啡店的常客。
Maintenance checks are done on a regular basis.
維護檢查是定期進行的。

items.pos: v. 發布；釋放 | n. 發行
items.colloc: press release 新聞稿 | release a product 發布產品
items.distinct: publish 出版 | announce 宣告
ex: The company will release the report tomorrow.
公司將於明天發布該報告。
A new version of the software was released.
該軟體的新版本已經發布了。
Please issue a press release to the media.
請對媒體發布一份新聞稿。

items.pos: adj. 預訂的；保留的；矜持的
items.colloc: reserved seat 預留座位 | reserved for 專供...
items.distinct: conserved 保存的 | preserved 保存的（食物）
ex: All seats for the gala are reserved.
晚宴的所有座位都已預訂。
This parking space is reserved for visitors.
此停車位是保留給訪客使用的。
The manager has a reserved attitude toward the plan.
經理對這項計畫態度較為保留。

items.pos: n. 資源；財力；對策
items.colloc: human resources 人力資源 | natural resources 天然資源
items.distinct: source 來源 | resort 手段；避難所
ex: We lack the resources to finish this project.
我們缺乏完成此專案的資源。
The human resources department handles staff training.
人力資源部負責員工培訓。
Time is our most valuable resource right now.
時間是我們目前最寶貴的資源。

items.pos: n. 回應；回覆；反應
items.colloc: in response to 回應 | quick response 快速反應
items.distinct: answer 答案；回答 | reaction 反應
ex: I am waiting for his response to the email.
我正在等他回覆電子郵件。
Customer response to the new product was positive.
顧客對新產品的反應是正面的。
They sent a letter in response to our inquiry.
他們寄了一封信回應我們的詢問。

items.pos: v. 回來；歸還；回報 | n. 回報；收益
items.colloc: return policy 退貨政策 | return on investment 投資報酬
items.distinct: refund 退款 | repay 償還
ex: Please return the borrowed items by Friday.
請在週五前歸還借用的物品。
The company expects a high return on this project.
公司預期此專案會有高收益。
She will return to the office after her trip.
她出差後將回到辦公室。

items.pos: v. 揭露；洩漏；展現
items.colloc: reveal the truth 揭露真相 | reveal a plan 透露計畫
items.distinct: uncover 發現 | disclose 公開
ex: The survey will reveal the customer's true needs.
這項調查將揭露顧客的真實需求。
He refused to reveal the details of the contract.
他拒絕透露合約的細節。
The new design reveals a modern business style.
新設計展現出摩登的商務風格。

items.pos: n. 銷售；拍賣；減價
items.colloc: on sale 特價中 | annual sale 年度特賣
items.distinct: sell 賣（動詞）| salary 薪水
ex: Our sales figures increased significantly this quarter.
我們本季的銷售額大幅成長。
The winter items are currently on sale.
冬季商品目前正在特價中。
We need to boost our sales before the year ends.
我們需要在年底前提升業績。

items.pos: adj. 感到滿意的；滿足的
items.colloc: customer satisfied 顧客滿意 | feel satisfied with 對...感到滿意
items.distinct: satisfying 令人滿意的 | content 滿足的
ex: We want to keep our clients fully satisfied.
我們希望讓客戶完全滿意。
Are you satisfied with the current service level?
你對目前的服務水準感到滿意嗎？
He was satisfied with the final project result.
他對最終的專案成果感到滿意。

items.pos: v. 選擇；挑選 | adj. 精選的
items.colloc: select a candidate 挑選候選人 | carefully select 精心挑選
items.distinct: choose 選擇（通用）| elect 選舉
ex: Management will select the best team for the task.
管理層將挑選最棒的團隊負責此任務。
We need to select a date for the launch event.
我們需要選定發表會的日期。
Please select your preferred language from the menu.
請從選單中選擇你偏好的語言。

items.pos: v. 運送；出貨 | n. 船
items.colloc: ship goods 出貨 | shipping cost 運費
items.distinct: deliver 遞送 | transport 運輸
ex: We will ship your order within three days.
我們將在三天內出貨您的訂單。
The shipping department is busy today.
出貨部門今天很忙碌。
How long does it take to ship to Taiwan?
運送到台灣需要多久時間？

items.pos: v. 睡覺 | n. 睡眠
items.colloc: get enough sleep 獲得充足睡眠 | sleep on it 考慮一下
items.distinct: nap 小睡 | doze 打瞌睡
ex: Make sure you get enough sleep before the trip.
出差前請確保有充足的睡眠。
He needs to sleep on the offer before deciding.
他需要考慮一下這個提議再決定。
It is difficult to sleep when working late hours.
在深夜工作時很難入睡。

items.pos: v. 撥出；節省 | adj. 多餘的；備用的
items.zh: 撥出；節省；多餘的；備用的
items.colloc: spare time 空閒時間 | spare parts 備用零件
items.distinct: extra 額外的 | reserve 保留的
ex: Can you spare a moment to discuss this?
你能撥出一點時間討論這件事嗎？
The technician brought some spare parts for repair.
技術員帶了一些備用零件來維修。
I have no spare cash to invest this month.
我這個月沒有多餘的現金可以投資。

items.pos: n. 代替品；代理人 | v. 代替
items.colloc: substitute for 代替... | perfect substitute 完美替代品
items.distinct: replace 取代 | alternate 交替
ex: You can use butter as a substitute for oil.
你可以用奶油作為油的替代品。
The manager will substitute for the director today.
經理今天將代理總監的職務。
There is no substitute for hard work and experience.
努力工作與經驗是無可替代的。

items.pos: v. 建議；提議；暗示
ex: I suggest that we move the meeting to Friday.
我建議將會議改到週五。
Could you suggest a good place for lunch?
你可以推薦一個吃午餐的好地方嗎？
The data suggests a decline in market interest.
數據顯示市場興趣有下降趨勢。
items.colloc: strongly suggest 強烈建議 | suggest a solution 提出解決方案
items.distinct: propose 提議（更正式）| recommend 推薦

items.pos: adj. 不舒服的；不自在的
items.colloc: feel uncomfortable 感到不自在 | uncomfortable chair 不舒服的椅子
items.distinct: awkward 尷尬的 | uneasy 心神不寧的
ex: The office chair makes me feel quite uncomfortable.
辦公椅讓我坐起來很不舒服。
He looked uncomfortable during the performance review.
他在績效評估期間看起來很不自在。
It is uncomfortable to sit in this small room.
待在這個小房間裡讓人很不舒服。

items.pos: n. 理解；諒解 | adj. 善解人意的
items.colloc: mutual understanding 相互理解 | clear understanding 清晰的理解
items.distinct: comprehension 理解力 | interpretation 解釋
ex: We reached an understanding about the budget.
我們對於預算達成了諒解。
Thank you for your understanding regarding this delay.
感謝您對這次延遲的體諒。
Having a good understanding of the market is key.
對市場有透徹的理解是關鍵。

items.pos: n. 工資；薪水
items.colloc: minimum wage 最低工資 | hourly wage 時薪
items.distinct: salary 薪資（月薪/年薪）| income 收入
ex: The company increased the hourly wage for staff.
公司提高了員工的時薪。
He is satisfied with his current weekly wage.
他對目前的週薪感到滿意。
Most workers are fighting for a living wage.
大多數工人都在爭取基本生活工資。
